info.description: SEO & analytics for the public website: Google Analytics / Tag Manager and Google Search Console. Changes reach the site within a minute.

googleAnalyticsId.description: Google tag ID: the GA4 Measurement ID (G-ABC123XYZ, Admin → Data streams → Web) or a Google tag ID (GT-…). The site loads gtag.js itself — no snippet needed. Empty = off.

googleTagManagerId.description: Google Tag Manager container ID, e.g. GTM-NZZ2KTHW. The site loads gtm.js itself (no snippet needed) and pushes a "plannity_page_view" event on every page — use it as the trigger for your GA4 tags in GTM. If GA4 runs inside GTM, leave googleAnalyticsId empty to avoid counting twice.

analyticsEnabled.description: Quick switch: turn Analytics off without deleting the ID.

requireCookieConsent.description: Ask visitors before loading Analytics (recommended under Thailand's PDPA). Off = load for everyone.

googleSiteVerification.description: Google Search Console → Add property → URL prefix → HTML tag. Paste the whole <meta> tag or just its content value.
